description: Returns trade records disclosed by U.S. members of Congress under the STOCK Act (Senate eFD and House Clerk Periodic Transaction Reports): one disclosed transaction by a member or their immediate family per row. The same filings are published free as news at https://keyvex.com/disclosures under 5 U.S.C. § 13107(c). These are DISCLOSED trades, due within 45 days and some filed later: disclosure_date is when the public could first see the trade, transaction_date when it happened. Amounts are STOCK Act ranges (e.g. '$1,001 - $15,000'); amount_min and amount_max hold the bounds. Each record's party is the party the member held on the date of the record (a trade's transaction date, a disclosure's filing date); for a date outside the member's terms in office, the party of their nearest term (the last one before that date, or the first one after it). Amendments, superseded rows and non-market events: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_congressional_trades

amendment_status.description: Default all. Most amendment rows add disclosures, not duplicates. House: 'unknown' only where the report shows no status (scans).

bioguide_id.description: Congressional ID, e.g. 'C001035'; preferred over member_name.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor, verbatim; keep filters and sort identical.

exclude_superseded.description: Drop rows a later filing restates or withdraws. Default false: SET IT WHEN SUMMING AMOUNTS, or totals double-count.

include_non_open_market.description: false: market trades plus unclassified rows only (no gifts, exchanges or corporate actions). Default false with transaction_type, else true.

min_amount.description: amount_min >= this (USD): the range's lower bound.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

sort_by.description: Also the since/until field. Default disclosure_date.

transaction_type.description: buy = Purchase (P); sell = full or partial Sale (S); exchange = Exchange (E). Omit for all three.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

name: get_congressional_trades
